title: Production Builds and Deployment
keywords: development tools, build systems, and integration
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of production builds and deployment and when it is appropriate.
Apply development versus production output using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check minified assets and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study production builds and deployment and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Production Builds and Deployment is part of a reproducible delivery workflow. Pin versions, keep source files distinct from generated output, confirm licensing and asset paths, and inspect the built artifacts rather than relying only on a development preview.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Production Builds and Deployment is part of a reproducible delivery workflow. Pin versions, keep source files distinct from generated output, confirm licensing and asset paths, and inspect the built artifacts rather than relying only on a development preview.

content_blocks.text: Use the pinned Bootstrap 5.3.x baseline, follow the official component documentation, and verify semantic HTML, responsive behavior, and keyboard access before reusing the pattern.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating production builds and deployment as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
